name: Ghost-trap
description: A box the cult uses to hold Tamiyo's scroll echo and harvest her stories.

description_citations.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
description_citations.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Cultists open a box and Tamiyo's shade appears; Nashi calls to her but she turns away.
timeline.quote: When they put it down, the top snapped open, and Tamiyo's shade appeared.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Nashi pulls his mother's scroll from the ghost-trap, and Tamiyo dissolves into moonlight.
timeline.quote: before she dissolved into moonlight and was gone.

citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.
